class.name: MermaidRender
class.brief_description: Renders Mermaid diagrams and exposes Merman's diagram data.
class.description: Create a [MermaidRender] instance to configure a diagram, export it, or read its layout for custom drawing. Call [method render] on the main thread. The operation is synchronous and stores its result on the instance. Use [method get_texture] for PNG or JPEG output, [method get_output_text] for SVG, ASCII, or JSON, and [method get_bytes] for binary data. The current SDK backend is available in Windows x64 MSVC builds with Merman enabled.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the output, metadata, and error.

method.name: get_bytes
method.description: Returns the raw output bytes of the last successful operation.

method.name: get_image
method.description: Decodes the current PNG or JPEG output into a new [Image]. Returns [code]null[/code] for other output formats or an empty result.

method.name: get_media_type
method.description: Returns the media type of the current output, such as [code]image/png[/code].

method.name: get_metadata
method.description: Returns a copy of Merman's metadata or structured error details for the last operation. For JSON operations, read the operation's data with [method get_output_text].

method.name: get_output_text
method.description: Returns SVG, ASCII, or JSON output as a string. Returns an empty string for binary output.

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the diagnostic message for the last failed operation. Returns an empty string after a successful operation.

method.name: get_runtime_catalog
method.description: Returns Merman's runtime catalog, including supported operation IDs in [code]capabilities.operation_ids[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary when the backend is unavailable.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Creates a new [ImageTexture] from the current PNG or JPEG output. Keep the returned texture if you plan to draw it repeatedly.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the Merman backend is available in this build.

method.name: render
method.description: Executes a Merman operation and replaces the previous result. Example IDs include [code]png[/code], [code]svg[/code], [code]pdf[/code], [code]semantic-json[/code], [code]layout-json[/code], and [code]validation-json[/code]. Consult [method get_runtime_catalog] for the full list. Pass Merman options as a dictionary with JSON-compatible values. Use [code]site_config[/code] for Mermaid settings, [code]raster[/code] for image export settings, and [code]presentation[/code] for Merman theme roles. Options depend on the operation. For document analysis, supply the document text and its [param uri]. [param timeout_msec] limits the operation in milliseconds. Use [code]0[/code] to run without a deadline. Returns [constant OK] when the operation produces a result. For validation and analysis operations, inspect the returned JSON for diagnostics.
